mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the floor and folding its projecting tabs made the fastening process concrete and easy to follow.

leastWorthwhile.text: The first tab fold was slightly ambiguous: the description said the tabs projected around the rim, while the goal called for folding them inward.

surprise.text: The floor slid over the straight tab tips before they were folded flat to secure it; that clarified the construction sequence.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the goals and visible fittings gave each a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the slit drum becomes an animation toy. The construction is clear, though the interface alone cannot convey how it feels to handle.
